trace_summary.task_objective: Retrieve every Wikipedia abstract required to verify this claim: Route 611 (Afghanistan) is not 100 kilometers and does not pass through the town that is found in the valley of the primary watershed for Sistan Basin.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system returned 24 documents (with duplicates) covering Route 611 (Afghanistan), Sangin, Helmand River, Sistan Basin, and related topics. The core abstracts needed to verify the claim were successfully retrieved in hop 1 and repeated in subsequent hops.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline successfully retrieved all Wikipedia abstracts necessary to verify the claim. In hop 1, the system retrieved the four key documents: Route 611 (Afghanistan) confirming the ~100km length and passage through Sangin; Sangin confirming its location in the Helmand River valley; Helmand River confirming it is the primary watershed for Sistan Basin; and Sistan Basin providing context. The summarizer correctly identified that both parts of the negated claim are false. Hops 2 and 3 re-retrieved the same core documents plus additional related articles. While the query generation and subsequent hops showed some redundancy, the task objective—to retrieve every abstract needed for verification—was accomplished in the first hop and maintained throughout. The system correctly did not emit a verification verdict, as specified in the task design.
